notes.title: QoL Update | Auto raids & more
notes.content: [p]This update is all about QoL and making your gameplay a little more pleasant and streamlined. Huge thanks to Uraxys and anyone else involved with the development of Idle Plus as a good chunk of these changes are inspired by the great work done there.[/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Raids[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new in-app purchase has been added that upon activation allows you to AFK raids. There is a single token, AFK Raider, that upon activation lets you choose which raid you'd like to gain the ability to AFK in. The token is as usual tradeable so you can buy it from other players via the player market as well. AFK raiding comes with a few caveats:[/p][list][*][p]You'll need to have completed a raid at least once to AFK it. In Bloodmoon Massacre, your able to base your AFK run based on waves you've managed to reach in manual runs. You're encouraged to do as well as you can in manual raids as your best manual times are what AFK runs are based on[/p][/*][*][p]AFKing a raid produces rewards much slower than raiding manually. The times it takes to complete an AFK raid is your best manual solo run time * 5 (at the time of writing). So if your best solo Reckoning of the Gods run is 10 minutes, an AFK Reckoning of the Gods run will take 50 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]You can't do another activity whilst AFK raiding[/p][/*][*][p]You don't receive experience from AFK raiding[/p][/*][*][p]You don't receive clan credits from AFK raiding[/p][/*][*][p]AFK raid completions are not counted towards your personal raid completions, leaderboards or the clan cup[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum AFK raid time is 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]You can AFK raid whilst offline, even up to the entire 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]Summed up, manual raiding is far superior to AFK raiding. But, if you're unable (or unwilling) to engage with raids manually, there is now an alternative option available[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Raids page has been slightly rearranged to display information in a more compact way. Also, you can now see your personal best solo runs in that view (not tracked at an individual level before this update so old run times won't show).[/p][/*][*][p]Bloodmoon massacre now remembers your previous bag loadout and lets you easily reselect it[/p][/*][*][p]Your best RotG time will now only be recorded if your ending party size matches your runs starting party size[/p][/*][*][p]Added Agility to the list of used skills in RotG and BMM as your dodge chance is now based on your agility level[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing player names in raid lobbies now shows the player's entire profile rather than just relevant skills[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]The item hover popup has been reworked to contain a lot more information[/b][/p][list][*][p]Current player market price (highest buy price or lowest sell price if there are no buy offers)[/p][/*][*][p]Stat differences compared to currently equipped item in same slot[/p][/*][*][p]Basic equipment info like level requirement, boosts etc[/p][/*][*][p]Applied and missing enchantments in jewelry[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Player info popup[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now used more often throughout the game when clicking player names in various places[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Invite to party" and "Join party" buttons for combat and raid parties[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a small visual annoyance where UI elements would get shown before getting populated with the latest data. Things are now hidden until they are fully loaded[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a small issue where the levels of a viewed online player could be slightly out of date[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Chat messages[/b][/p][list][*][p]Left clicking/pressing chat messages now opens the player's info popup (same popup as used when viewing clan members)[/p][/*][*][p]Right clicking chat messages now copies the senders username to your clipboard[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Premium clarity changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]To be a bit less "in your face" with an in-app purchase, pressing premium locked content as a non-premium player will no longer straight up open up the game shop with premium benefits thrown at you. Instead, it'll open up a new popup that tells you a bit about the rank and lets you know that it can be bought with in-game gold as well. There are buttons that direct you both to the game shop and the player market with premium pre-searched[/p][/*][*][p]Reworded premium's description in the game shop to be a bit clearer about its tradeability and purchasability with in-game gold[/p][/*][*][p]When buying tokens from the game shop, you'll now automatically be taken to your inventory with the token selected to hopefully make it clearer that you need to activate the token to unlock its benefits[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Misc. QoL changes & additions[/b][/p][list][*][p]To not make the item requirements for the "Clan boss slayers" upgrade completely useless after you've unlocked the upgrade for your clan and to add another needed source of Otherworldly essence, these items can now be broken into essence[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing the placeholder toggle in your inventory page now displays a notification informing you of what you've done[/p][/*][*][p]The Valley of the Gods keys now mention which boss they unlock access to in their item descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]The player market page no longer needs to be opened before being able to list items for sale from your inventory[/p][/*][*][p]You'll now see how much potion usage you'll get when drinking potions[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of holiday currency you get from buying it via the game shop hasn't been modified in a long time, causing the deals to not be very worthwhile due to gold inflation. Thus, for future events, the amount of holiday currency you get has now been tripled[/p][/*][*][p]The "Get Questing token" button in the quests popup that shows up when you don't have the quester rank active was reworded to "Raise the amount of available quests with a Questing token", it's colour was changed and its pulse animation was removed[/p][/*][*][p]Ending solo combat now displays the more descriptive summary popup that was previously only used for group combat sessions[/p][/*][*][p]The detailed loot/kills summary popup is now accessible in solo combat as well via the "Loot and stats" popup. Historical loot is no longer displayed as text in that view[/p][/*][*][p]Health you lifesteal during a combat session can now be seen in the "Loot and stats" popup[/p][/*][*][p]Player market item searches are now able to display up to 40 different items, up from 20[/p][/*][*][p]Sobek is now a part of the weekly clan cup[/p][/*][*][p]"Yoink" now applies to offline boss kills[/p][/*][*][p]Local market upgrades now display max tier. Also, the tier text is now white[/p][/*][*][p]Lil' Eclipse now has an item description and mentions how its levelled up[/p][/*][*][p]The agility icon is now displayed in damage splats if the attack was dodged. Currently only in regular combat[/p][/*][*][p]You can now click player names in the clan recruitment centre to view their profiles[/p][/*][*][p]You can now click player names in clan boss lobbies to view their profiles[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing player names in combat lobbies now shows the player's entire profile rather than just relevant skills and equipment[/p][/*][*][p]If you're logging out or quitting the application without performing an offline supported activity, you'll now be warned that you'll go idle. On mobile, only log outs via the sidebar menu will trigger the warning[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused GIM accounts who were kicked out of a clan whilst being offline and who had an active task when logging out to be kicked out of the game shortly after logging back into the game due to an unhandled exception[/p][/*][*][p]The "Through the wetlands" upgrade was showing an incorrect percentage on non-English languages[/p][/*][*][p]A temporary chat channel being deleted will no longer default to the General chat being toggled on, unless the deleted chat was the chat you had open[/p][/*][*][p]The vault space bulk purchase now warns that you already have the maximum amount of vault space if you do[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed receiving skilling gloves not unlocking collection log slots. Should now work via the skilling party event and also via claimable items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where your raid lobby status wouldn't get cleared on logout, rendering you unable to, for example, join new raid parties after logging out or being disconnected until you manually cleared it by creating a new lobby or restarting the client[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where your BMM completion wouldn't be recorded if you left the raid before it finished. You would still receive rewards for it, but the run wouldn't be recorded to leaderboards, clan cup and with this update, your personal best runs[/p][/*][*][p]Damage dealt in Reckoning of the Gods and Bloodmoon massacre no longer overkills[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Kronos' weaknesses not being applied in combat[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly modified Ancient tribe drop table so that weights adds up to exactly 100%[/p][/*][*][p]Your current activity will no longer be marked as combat in your profile unless you're actually in combat (previously simply being in a combat lobby would suffice)[/p][/*][*][p]Doing smelting in RotG will no longer show you as idle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the attack skill not appearing in player info popups when viewing online players[/p][/*][*][p]The key used to open a boss lobby wouldn't be used towards offline progression, meaning that you'd end up with 1 less kill at the end of it than you should have[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Our first summer event, Beach party, has started! Bonus experience for all!
notes.content:
[p]Our first summer event, Beach party, has started! 

Similar to other events but this time with ice cream, you can donate the event currency to the communal supply which increases a global experience boost for everyone in the game. Ice cream can be bought with either in-game gold or for real money through the game shop. Additionally, you can find ice cream when opening chests and killing bosses in The Valley of Gods.
[/p][p]As we reach predetermined ice cream milestones in the supply, the experience bonus everyone in the game receives increases. The experience bonus starts at 2% at caps out at 25%. The event ends on the 8th of August at which time you'll be unable to donate any more ice cream to the supply. The supply will start draining at an accelerated rate and you'll keep receiving bonus experience until the supply is empty. 
[/p][p]Same as previous events, there's a new Discord role @2025 Beach party benefactor available for players who end up in the Top Donors (top 30) list at the end of the event.

Enjoy the bonus experience![/p]

notes.title: New end-game boss, new tasks & summer bonus experience event
notes.content: [p]This update brings new end-game tasks and a new high level boss: Sobek.[/p][p][/p][p]To fight Sobek, you'll need to get your hands on Ancient keys. These keys are obtainable from Plundering the "Ancient tribe", which requires a Plundering level of 105 and utilizes every non-combat skill in the game. Sobek has a chance of dropping some new best in slot items along with providing access to a new upgrade.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, we're running our first summer themed event soon. Beach party will start at 8AM UTC on the 25th and run for exactly 2 weeks. The maximum experience boost from this event will be 25%.[/p][p]Full patch notes below:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Plundering task[/b][/p][list][*][p]Level requirement of 105[/p][/*][*][p]Every non-combat skill counts as an advantage and benefits cap at level 110[/p][/*][*][p]Drops[/p][list][*][p]A key/ticket to fight a new boss, Sobek[/p][/*][*][p]Ingredients for dishes[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New boss in the Valley of Gods, Sobek[/b][/p][list][*][p]A unique mechanic where the boss will become immune to the attack style it was previously damaged with. This means that the boss should be taken on in a group with different attack styles or if that's not an option, you'll have to fight it without an attack style. This means either fighting it with your bare fists or getting yourself the new Primeval fangblade[/p][/*][*][p]Uses Archery, similar stats to Medusa but stronger[/p][/*][*][p]A new weekly quest has been added where killing Sobek a handful of times is required[/p][/*][*][p]Access requires an Ancient key[/p][/*][*][p]Because acquiring keys to fight Sobek takes a fairly long time, it uses the same loot distribution logic as Kronos where the team leader will always get the drop regardless of damage dealt[/p][/*][*][p]The "Show us the money" upgrade works when fighting Sobek as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Drops[/p][list][*][p]Sobek's talisman[/p][/*][*][p]Sobek's blessing[/p][/*][*][p]Sobek's charm[/p][/*][*][p]Arrow of Sobek[/p][/*][*][p]Blessed crocodile hide[/p][/*][*][p]Raw apex meat. Cooking it requires level 100 Cooking and the cooked variant heals for 20 health when consumed[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New items[/b][/p][list][*][p]Primeval fangblade[/p][list][*][p]Creation requires a Smithing level of 90 and the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Primeval fang (dropped by Drake)[/p][/*][*][p]Astronomical bar[/p][/*][*][p]25 ancient potions[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Untradeable[/p][/*][*][p]Base stats slightly worse than Godlike longsword[/p][/*][*][p]Unique aspects make it the ideal choice of weapon against Sobek[/p][list][*][p]This blade doesn't have a defined attack style. This means that it can be used against Sobek without it triggering its immunity effect[/p][/*][*][p]30% damage boost against Sobek[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Divine hide buckler[/p][list][*][p]Requires a Divine buckler and 5 Blessed crocodile hides[/p][/*][*][p]Created with the Smithing skill with a level requirement of 100[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Naga's blessed crown[/p][list][*][p]Requires Naga's crown and Sobek's charm[/p][/*][*][p]Created with the Smithing skill with a level requirement of 105[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sobek's blessing - A scroll equipable in the ammunition slot. Scroll provides some strength and accuracy bonuses and is the first item in that equipment slot to do so. Tradeable[/p][/*][*][p]Arrow of Sobek - a unique ammunition that doesn't get consumed when shot. Archery strength slightly lower than that of Titanium arrows. Untradeable[/p][/*][*][p]Sobek's talisman - Used to unlocks the "Through the wetlands" upgrade which raises your skilling ticket drop chance by 30%. Untradeable[/p][/*][*][p]A cooking experience bonus outfit has been added and is obtainable from the Cooking clan event[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Other changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]You should now see your Player market trading history immediately updated when finalizing trades[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The Smithing tab now contains a "Other" tab that we'll utilize primarily for creation of high level equipment with unique item requirements. Primeval fangblade, Divine hide buckler and Naga's blessed crown are created via that menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Attempting to equip a loadout where you don't own all of the loadout's items will now equip whatever items you do have rather than the loadout equip fully failing. You can then go to loadout configuration and more easily update the loadout as necessary[/p][/*][*][p]Collection log   - Astronomical ore is now a part of Valley of the Gods collection logs   - Sobek has been added to the Collection log[/p][/*][*][p]The following items are now sorted under the Resources tab (cube icon) in your inventory[/p][list][*][p]Holiday currencies[/p][/*][*][p]Boss keys[/p][/*][*][p]Item requirements in new Smithing tasks[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sometimes players that disconnected in unexpected ways would remain visible to you in clan boss fights. That should no longer happen[/p][/*][*][p]Disconnected clients should get cleaned up quicker now. You should not be disconnected for being inactive in the game, only if your connection has dropped and your client is unable to communicate with the server, so ideally, assuming this change works as intended, the change shouldn't be visible to you in any other way besides reconnection being smoother after having connection issues. This fix should indirectly fix at least a couple of known issues players have occasionally faced:[/p][list][*][p]Clan boss fights should no longer appear stuck when a party member ungracefully disconnects from the fight[/p][/*][*][p]There has been an issue with clan operations sometimes failing and getting stuck, causing players to be unable to interact with the clan or even login (as the login process touches clan data as well). I'm hopeful that the change fixes this issue - but even if not, these issues should be resolving much faster than before.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed "Show us the money" procs not registering in the collection log[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Raid #3: Bloodmoon massacre | Potion changes & more
notes.content:
[b]Our third raid is out: Bloodmoon massacre[/b]
[list]
[*] Infinite waves until your party inevitably falls. Each wave is harder than the last and the further you get, the better your chances at lucrative rewards
[*] You'll bring your own equipment into this raid. Additionally, you can by default bring up to 4 equipable items into the raid with you. This is doubled to 8 with the Bloodmoon preparation upgrade - more on that below
[*] As this raid doesn't have a defined end, the rewards work slightly differently from what you're used to. Boss fights start at wave 10 and repeat every 5 waves afterwards. After every boss fight, you'll receive a guaranteed default loot roll. On wave 20 and afterwards, you'll have a chance of receiving a high roller loot roll on top of the default roll. The chance of receiving this extra roll raises as you progress in the raid. High roller loot rolls are essentially 5x as powerful as default loot rolls. Received loot rolls are immediately recorded and will be usable later even if you suddenly leave the raid or disconnect.
[*] As this raid is never completed, leaderboards and clan cup don't count your completions like they typically do. Instead, they're are ordered by the wave you manage to get to. Bloodmoon massacre leaderboards and clan cup standings are available for both players and clans
[/list]

notes.title: Inventory management, Clan tags & more

notes.title: New clan content!
notes.content:
[b]New clan event: Skilling party[/b]  

[list]  
[*] Requires a new type of currency to enter - skilling tickets. Similar to chests, these can be found whilst skilling and are dropped at a slightly higher drop rate than exceptional chests. They are automatically submitted to your clan's collection as you receive them.  
[*] You can create a party for a skill when you have at least 1 ticket for that skill. If you have multiple, they'll all be used and rewards will scale accordingly.  
[*] Tickets cap at 10 per skill to prevent funnelling.  
[*] No cooldowns or daily limits.  
[*] Experience is about half of what you get from other skilling events per ticket.  
[*] Loot:  
   [list]  
   [*] Resources based on your clan's level in used skill.  
   [*] 1% chance to receive a pet per ticket.  
   [*] 2% chance to receive skilling gloves per used ticket. More on skilling gloves below.  
   [*] Loot is given to everyone in the clan when the event is completed, not just participants. Non-participating members can claim their loot via the bag icon in the clan front page.  
   [/list]  
[/list]  

[b]New item type: Skilling gloves[/b]  

[list]  
[*] For gathering and crafting skills, skilling gloves provide a 5% chance to double your loot (does not grant extra experience) when completing tasks. This stacks with existing mechanics, so if you, for example, proc "The Fisherman" upgrade to double your fish, skilling gloves will potentially double the already doubled fish.  
[*] As Agility doesn't produce items, Agility gloves work differently. When worn, you'll have a chance to receive random boss keys instead of chests whilst doing any skill:  
   [list]  
   [*] 75% chance to receive a key instead of common chests.  
   [*] 50% chance to receive a key instead of rare chests.  
   [*] 25% chance to receive a key instead of exceptional chests.  
   [/list]  
[/list]  

[b]New clan upgrade: Ways of the Genie[/b]  

[list]  
[*] Unlocking it permanently raises Otherworldly Essence's effect from 30% to 72% for all clan members.  
[*] Costs 250k clan credits.  
[*] Requires your clan to have used a total of at least 1,000 skilling tickets.  
[/list]  

[b]Other[/b]  

[list]  
[*] The inventory space token activation cap was raised from 5 to 10, bringing in 150 new inventory slots for use.  
[*] When attempting to leave a clan as GIM, the confirmation popup now has a 15-second timer until the confirm button can be pressed. Kicking players has the same functionality.  
[/list]  

[b]Bug fixes & tweaks - some of these already went live as minor patches[/b]  

[list]  
[*] Made some improvements to data initialization on game startup. Hopefully, some lower-end devices that weren't able to load the game before will be able to play now as well.  
[*] Fixed some issues in the Group Ironman clan standings leaderboard tab.  
[*] Fixed about a dozen texts in the game not being localized correctly.  
[*] Fixed the "Kronos who?" upgrade requiring only a total of 50 Valley of the Gods kills rather than needing to have killed each of them at least 50 times.  
[*] Fixed an issue where if you DM'd a user after creating a party chat and had the DM chat active when the party chat dissolved, you wouldn't be able to open any other channels until closing the DM chat.  
[*] Attempting to enter Reckoning of the Gods now specifies that you need 25 kills in the Valley of the Gods rather than general boss kills.  
[*] Fixed an issue with new skilling equipment not being sorted as such when auto-sorting your inventory.  
[*] The X button in the confirmation popup now acts as a background click.  
[*] Fixed offline Exterminating not awarding quest kills as it should've.  
[*] Block icon in raids was using the wrong icon, fixed.  
[*] Fixed an issue with retrieving clan logs.  
[*] Added Exterminating to leaderboard Standings pages.  
[/list]  

[b]Valentine's event[/b]  

The event will start on the 14th of February at 9AM UTC. This event normally lasts for a week, but due to our Christmas event ending prematurely, I've set this one to run for 2 weeks. Additionally, as the Christmas event ended with 10B still in the supply, I'll be sneakily donating that amount to this event once it starts.

notes.title: New skill: Exterminating
notes.content:
The first skill since the game's launch has been added - Exterminating!

To train it, you'll need to find the Exterminating experts in the Exterminating tab. Experts become available to you based on your health level so you'll be able to get suitable assignments for your skill level right away. 

These experts can assign you monsters to hunt and when you're killing monsters on assignment, you'll receive some experience in Exterminating. The monsters they assign are a combination of old monsters you've already fought and about a dozen new ones. 

The new Exterminating monsters have Exterminating level requirements and you won't be able to fight them until that level requirement is met. You also won't be able to fight them without them being your current assignment.

[h2]Exterminating points[/h2]
[list]
[*] Completing Exterminating assignments awards you with Exterminating points
[list]
[*] These can be used in the new Exterminating shop. It currently contains 2 items to purchase:
[list]
[*] Cancel assignment - cancels your current assignment. This is a repeating purchase
[*] Auto completer - purchased once and unlocked indefinitely. With this, you'll automatically receive and start new Exterminating assignments as you complete them. Works both online and offline
[/list]
[*] The game shop has a new tradeable token for $3.99 that when activate, you'll permanently receive 25% more Exterminating points from assignments
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]What happens to existing completionist capes?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Currently, nothing. Exterminating does not yet have its own skill cape so your existing completionist capes will continue working as before
[/list]
The skill is still far from finished. I didn't want to overwhelm you (and myself) with too much stuff at once but you can expect additions to the Exterminating shop, Exterminating monster drop tables and eventually new Exterminating monsters as well. I hope even in its current state it'll keep you entertained for a good while though - there is a fair amount of stuff to go through and obtain!
I'll leave the rest for you to figure out!

Note: Exterminating won't appear in Leaderboards quite yet

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Skilling pages can now be dragged by pressing empty space between instantiated elements
[*] Build sizes should now be significantly smaller
[*] Fixed pressing the "'Player' sent you an item" notification not opening the item withdrawal popup if you weren't in the profile page
[*] Item requirements for upgrades are now displayed more clearly
[*] All monsters in the game have received graphical updates to be a little more "flat" and more in tune with the rest of the game (note: known issue that some monsters may appear slightly smaller than they should on some platforms)
[*] Small bug fixes and tweaks here and there that went untracked
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly clan cup, macOS support & general improvements
notes.content:
[h1]The clan cup is here![/h1]

Clan cup is a constantly running tournament that resets every Sunday at 4PM UTC. Clans can compete with against each other in dozens of categories and receive small rewards for ranking high in categories at the end of the week. If your clan finishes top 10 in any category, you'll receive a small amount of clan credits and your standing will be recorded to all-time stats. The primary motivation to participate in clan cups should simply be for fun and to enjoy a little competition on the side from your regular gameplay.

There are a total of 36 categories that clans can compete in. They're split as follows:

[list]
[*] Skilling categories
   [list]
   [*] Every non-combat skill included
   [*] Clans with the highest experience win
   [/list]
[*] Combat categories
   [list]
   [*] Every Valley of the Gods boss and clan boss included
   [*] These are separated into 2 different categories
      [list]
      [*] Kill count
      [*] Fastest kills
      [/list]
   [/list]
[*] Raid categories
   [list]
   [*] Both raids included
   [*] These are separated into 2 different categories as well
      [list]
      [*] Completion count
      [*] Completion speed
      [/list]
   [/list]
[/list]

Top 10 clans in every category will receive clan credits and points towards all-time ranking for Clan cups.

[list]
[*] Rank 1: 5,000 credits
[*] Rank 2: 3,500 credits
[*] Rank 3: 3,000 credits
[*] Rank 4: 2,500 credits
[*] Rank 5: 2,000 credits
[*] Rank 6: 1,500 credits
[*] Rank 7: 1,000 credits
[*] Rank 8: 750 credits
[*] Rank 9: 500 credits
[*] Rank 10: 250 credits
[/list]

These rewards are halved for ironman clans.

Clan cup stats can be opened from the top right menu. Please note that it'll take some time for clan cup stats to update so viewing the clan cup initially will be awfully empty. All-time stats will be uploaded for the first time when the first cup ends.

[h2]Mac support[/h2]

[list]
[*] The game can now played on macOS via Steam
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The clan bulletin board is now displayed when you open the clan page for the first time. It won't be shown again until/if the bulletin board is modified
[*] Clan boss cards now show the amount of players currently in battle
[*] The clan boss loot popup was reworked to be more like the clan event loot popup. Should now be more compact and easier to find what you're looking for
[*] You're no longer prompted to select a username when creating a guest account. Instead, you'll be thrown right into the game and given a temporary guest name
[list]
[*]The guest registration popup was also slightly improved and polished
[/list]
[*] When viewing quests, the displayed pet now has a little green checkmark if you already own the pet and a red cross if you don't
[*] The Keep it burning upgrade now increments quest completions for any relevant active cooking quests for all the meat you cooked rather than just 1
[*] Pressing the "Player sent you an item" notification now opens up your item withdrawal box
[*] Pressing the "Quest completed" notification now opens up the quests popup
[*] To better manage server resources, you'll now be disconnected from the server if you're idle for more than 30 minutes. This doesn't mean that you can't leave the game open and go AFK for example - the timer will only tick if your game isn't communicating with the server in any way. If you're performing any activity in the game, the timer won't tick and you shouldn't be disconnected
[*] Additionally, the server should now more quickly detect and disconnect clients that have been ungracefully disconnected (such as plugging your network cable or shutting down your WiFi)
[*] All values in the task stats popup are now formatted
[*] Combat quests now also show the green checkmark if you're currently working on the quest
[*] The reroll button in the quests popup is now red
[*] God weapons from the Reckoning of the Gods have been graphically updated
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in clan boss fights where users disconnecting ungracefully could cause the fight to partially (it seems that the fight would still continue in the background as it should but player wouldn't receive information about it) halt until the server was able to properly dispose of the disconnected player
[*] Patched a rare bug that could cause your saved profiles to not be loaded to the left of the main menu
[*] Fixed chat notifications not appearing in the clan boss view
[*] Fixed a visual issue where if you didn't have boss hunter unlocked, received boss keys would be added to your inventory even if you had a Kronos book. The keys would be gone on relog or if you tried to interact with them
[*] The task stats popup still referenced "ad boosts" rather than "daily boosts" which is what they're consistently called now
[*] Fixed a small issue where new users wouldn't gain any feedback from trying to create a raid lobby - it would just silently fail and not tell you why
[*] Fixed some inconsistencies in the localizations of battleaxes and philosopher's stones
[*] Fixed clan boss leaderboard entries not showing up in player leaderboard searches
[*] A small section of the raid enemy info buttons were unclickable due to the enemy image slightly overlapping it
[*] Fixed a visual bug where non-premium players claiming daily boosts would appear to have claimed more daily boosts than they really did
[*] Fixed a bug where receiving an item into your inventory whilst having an inventory sorting option active and activating a cosmetic scroll effect, the item suggestions for a cosmetic effect would be replaced with your active sorting options
[/list]

[h2]API[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed boss kills and raid completions not showing up in player profile queries. The format in which they are returned was slightly modified
[/list]

notes.title: 22nd of July - Pets and quests update part 2
notes.content:
If you've been so lucky to receive pets before this update, gather them up because it's time for them to get to work!

[h1]Pets update[/h1]

[list]
[*] Skilling pets:
[list]
[*] Pets can now be levelled up. They share the same experience table as characters do
[*] Level up pets by sending them off to do tasks for you. Pets use the same tasks that are available to players, but the little fellas will take 4 times longer to complete tasks and do not use any unlocks you've made on your character such as upgrades. A slight difference is that pet tasks will never consume any gold, so Carpentry tasks for example won't cost you anything.
[*] You can only have a single pet to do a task for you at any given time
[*] When a pet completes their task, the produced item will be sent to your inventory. The pet will gain some experience and continue running the task just like your character would
[*] You will receive the experience your pet earns
[*] When completing tasks that have ingredient costs, pets will take the required items from your inventory
[list]
[*] Note: pets will skip the gold requirement if tasks have them (currently only Carpentry)
[/list]
[*] Pets will keep working when offline, just like your character does. Note: your character's offline progress if processed first, so if you both you and your pet are doing the same task whilst offline and you end up running out of resources, the pet might not end up producing anything
[*] As Agility and Enchanting tasks behave a bit differently from the others, so do the corresponding pets
[list]
[*] The Agility pet has a chance of finding you chests when completing tasks. The rate it finds them at is twice as high as normal. Other pets cannot find chests while skilling
[*] The Enchanting pet completes common, rare and exceptional tasks and earns itself and you experience without needing any scrolls. Not a lot of it, but hey, it's free!
[/list]
[*] While the rates might seem small at first, keep in mind that the activities the pets perform are completely separate from the player and everything you gain is just extra on top of whatever you're doing with your character. Introducing pets without them using existing modifiers will also allow us to more easily develop new content around pets.
[/list]
[*] Combat (Melee, Archery, Magic) pets:
[list]
[*] Received from daily & weekly combat quests at a higher chance than skilling pets. When completing combat quests, you'll receive one of these pets randomly. You won't receive duplicates until you've collected them all
[*] Combat pets behave very differently from skilling pets. They can not be sent off to do tasks for you, but rather you equip them to get the bonuses that they provide
[*] Combat pets receive a part of the experience you gain in combat when they're equipped. When certain experience thresholds are passed, you can upgrade your pet to the next tier and it'll provide higher bonuses
[*] Upgrading combat pets requires them to reach certain levels and costs gemstones and the costs from each tier carry over to the next one. For example, to upgrade to tier 2, you'll need 3 refined gemstones. Tier 3 takes 3 refined and great gemstones. Tier 4 takes 3 refined, great and elite gemstones, and so on
[/list]
[*] Pets have their own leaderboards 
[*] Manage your pets from the inventory tab
[/list]

[h1]Quest update[/h1]

[list]
[*] Weekly quests have been added
[list]
[*] Weekly quests consist of new some new quests that can take a while to complete, like finding gemstones from combat, and the same skilling quests seen in daily quests but with bigger numbers
[*] 4 weekly quests available by default, up to 6 with the quester rank
[*] Weekly quests have separate rerolls from dailies: 6 default, up to 12 with the quester rank
[*] Weekly quests can be auto-completed but daily quests are always prioritized
[/list]
[*] New types of quests have been added
[list]
[*] Receive a specific item as a drop from combat (the loot credit has to go to you)
[*] Kill an enemy X amount of times (you don't have to receive the kill credit in group combat)
[*] Kill an enemy in a single hit (only given as dailies). These expect you to utilize the potion of dark magic (though not strictly required) so low level ones aren't assigned to ironmen
[list]
[*] Note: combat quests cannot be auto completed and will be skipped when auto completing
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Previously, you wouldn't be able to get more than 1 quest for a given skill - this has now been modified so that you're able to reroll more quests for the same skill if previous quest(s) with that skill have already been completed. This doesn't apply to Enchanting quests
[/list]

[h1]Daily boosts[/h1]

[list]
[*] Ads have been removed from the game. Non-premium members on Steam can now claim daily boosts and mobile players aren't shown ads at all. You still need premium to bypass the cooldown and stack your daily boosts. This was done for a couple of reasons:
[list]
[*] Telling non-premium PC players to either play on mobile or pay up to access a feature in the game was pretty awkward and not a good experience for new users
[*] Displaying ads on top of the game client is fairly complicated and issues often pop up in frameworks that power them. These can cause a variety of problems such as crashes, which negatively affect how the game is being shown on stores and can result in less potential players finding out about our game
[*] The revenue received from ads wasn't significant enough to justify their existence
[/list]
[*] Additionally, claiming your daily boost will now credit you with all available boosts if you have premium
[/list]

[list]
[*] Login issues that have occasionally impacted a small amount of users recently are hopefully fixed. Will continue to monitor the systems and make further adjustements if needed.
[*] Equipment UI in the inventory tab has been overhauled! Hopefully it's more pleasant to look at now and easier to make sense of for new players

[*] You'll no longer receive the "Are you sure you want to leave this view? You'll lose any uncollected rewards." confirmation popup when being invited to group activities whilst having the event popup open. You used to claim the items manually once an event ended but that's now automatic so the confirmation is redundant

notes.title: Player market overhaul, leaderboards rework, public API & more!
notes.content:
[b]The biggest change in this update is the fully reworked player market. You'll now be able to create buy offers on top of sell offers and the entire experience should be much smoother. We've also got the tools set up to display average prices and historical market data.[/b]

More than a few developers have wished for a public API and I'm glad to announce that it has arrived! You'll be able to query data from the player market, leaderboards, player profiles & more.

Lots to dive into, so let's get into it!

[b]Player market[/b]
[list]
[*]The player shops are now the player market and there are some significant changes!
[*]You can now create buy offers on top of sell offers
[*]The player market interacts with our new API to give you the data on the current and historical price data of items you look up
[*]You don't have to worry about underpricing or overpricing your items in most cases, the game attempts to find you the best deals available. For example, if you create a sell offer for coal for 1 gold each, the game will find the buy offers with the highest price for coal and execute those orders and that's what you'll get for the coal rather than 1 gold price you submitted. Works vice versa for buy offers as well.
[*]The items with the largest volume in the past 24 hours are displayed on the player market page
[*]Trading history has been updated to work with the new market along with some changes
[list]
[*]Trading history is now saved online rather than on disk so you'll always have the real data no matter what device you're playing on
[*]Trading history entries improved graphically
[*]Limited to the latest 20 entries
[/list]
[*]Your old listings can be accessed via the Legacy shop button on the Player market page. Other players can no longer interact with these listings, so you should delist them at your earliest convenience.
[/list]

[b]Leaderboards[/b]
[list]
[*]Leaderboards received a massive overhaul! You should notice a very significant difference in the speed at which leaderboards load and they'll consume less memory client side as well.
[*]Clans now keep track of boss kills and raid completions and they are now a part of clan leaderboards. Since they weren't tracked before, all clans start from zero in those fields as of this update
[*]Leaderboard client-side caches are now cleared on log out so instead of having to close the entire client to get updated leaderboards, you'll only need to relog
[*]Top list entries with 500m experience now show the time at which it was achieved as well
[*]All fields now show up in standings and clan standings, even if you're not ranked in them. If you aren't yet on the leaderboards in a given field, it'll just say you're unranked rather than hiding the field
[*]Total level and experience are now shown in the Clan standings page
[*]Clan leaderboard profiles now have a button leading to the clan's recruitment page
[*]Leaderboards were migrated to the new system earlier this morning so leaderboard entries may be a few hours out of date until you relog
[/list]

[b]Clan logs[/b]
[list]
[*]Clan logs popup can now hold 500 entries
[*]Clan logs now expire after 2 weeks
[*]Clan logs popup was made slightly bigger to give logs more space
[*]Vault logs were shortened a little bit
[*]The name of the currently viewed logs is now shown in the popup's title text
[*]Note: clan logs are currently processed in batches every 10 minutes, so they won't show up right away when a clan member does a thing
[*]Note 2: clan logs are cached client side for 10 minutes or until you relog, so even if clan logs have been processed, you might not see them right away
[/list]

[b]Public API[/b]
[list]
[*]Our API has been released! It contains endpoints for the player market, leaderboards, clans and players. This is just the initial version and it'll be expanded upon based on feedback
[*]Developers with serious projects can contact me to receive a key to access higher rate limits
[*]Simple documentation available at https://query.idleclans.com/api-docs
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes & tweaks (some already went live with the server restarts last week)[/b]
[list]
[*]Chat no longer accepts special characters
[*]Fixed error popups occurring during item listing being hidden under the shop management popup
[*]Fixed ironmen not being able to accept game shop items whilst offline

[*]The skilling event popup and the combat group loot info popup can now be closed from background clicks
[*]Ironmen can now accept game shop items from other players while offline

[*]Probably some other stuff that I forgot to write down, this update was a bit hectic.

notes.title: 15th of May updates - Quality of Life changes & bug squashes
notes.content:
The biggest changes in the update are backend ones. We've made lots of progress on and our backend systems are healthier than ever! Work on that front continues as we ensure our systems will be capable of running smoothly as the game and our player base grows.

The main changes that are visible to you as a player though would be the changes to player to player item sending and daily boosts. Read on!

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Player-to-player item sending changes. The item sending system was in need of a couple of tweaks to ensure that it'll continue to work as expected as we overhaul our backend systems this year for better scalability. Hopefully these changes will provide a more user friendly experience as well!
   [list]
   [*] Items can now be sent to offline players. Note: the recipients username is case insensitive but they'll need to log out once after this update lands for case insensitivity to work
   [*] Items are no longer directly added to the recipients inventory when sent - instead, they're added to an item withdrawal box which can be accessed from your profile. All items you receive from other players will be listed here and you'll need to claim them to add them to your inventory - or you can discard them if you don't appreciate someone's gift.
   [*] You can have 20 items from a specific player in your withdrawal box. Afterwards, you'll need to claim or discard the items for them to be able to send you more
   [*] Your item withdrawal box can hold 60 items in total
   [/list]
[*] Whitelisting system has been removed and you can now send items to anyone at any time. With these new changes in place, I believe the whitelisting system is just an extra step and an unnecessary headache as you'll now claim any items sent to you before they're added to your inventory
[*] Daily experience boost changes
   [list]
   [*] Premium players no longer have a 2h cooldown period when claiming daily boosts
   [*] Boost can be paused. After pausing and resuming the boost, there's a 3 minute cooldown before you can pause it again
   [*] Boost will not be consumed whilst offline if it's paused OR if you logged out whilst idle and the boost didn't get used on anything
   [*] 8 hours is still the limit per day and your boost carries over when days change. Your maximum boost time is 16 hours
   [/list]
[*] The settings popup now contains a "Blocks" tab where you can block other players. Blocking a player prevents them from sending you items, inviting you to combat and raids parties and you won't see their messages in chat
[*] Settings can now be accessed from main menu. The language dropdown was removed as a result as they can now be accessed from inside the settings popup
   [list]
   [*] Note: some tabs are unavailable in the main menu as their settings are player specific
   [/list]
[*] For better accuracy and to be less error prone, the combat stats calculations now uses session data to calculate your stats and are thus guaranteed to be accurate. There is also a "Simulate expected stats" which runs the simulation as it has done before so that you can instantly see what kind of stats you can expect to see with your current setup
[*] All smithable armour has been graphically reworked by ZoEzi!
[*] When listing an item for sale, the default price is now 0 instead of 1 and you'll be told to select a valid price if you attempt to list an item for 0 gold. This is to prevent accidental 1 gold sales that happen to the best of us from time to time
[*] Renamed Questing scroll to Questing token
[*] Default FPS target on mobile is now 30 instead of 60
[*] Excess whitespace is now removed from chat messages
[*] Added a loading screen to guest username updates and added a character limit to the input field
[*] Attempting to update your guest username to a name that's already taken will now tell you so rather than hitting you with the ambiguous "Operation couldn't be completed" error message
[*] Raids 1 & 2 have a new background
[*] A detailed error message is now displayed when you attempt to purchase items from the game shop on a standalone client that's been launched outside of Steam
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some quests not showing the exclamation mark in the quests popup even if you didn't have the resources to complete them
[*] Fixed typo in the "You need to be connected to the chat to do this" message
[*] Fixed a bug where if you had the clan view open when you got kicked out of the clan, your old clan would remain visible (but you wouldn't be able to interact with it)
[*] Fixed an unnecessary desync disconnect that would occur if you initiated an item sale, left the confirmation popup open and your owned item amount was less than originally when you confirm the sale
[*] Chat input field no longer accepts rich text
[*] The minimum selectable value in the clan quest donation slider is now 1 instead of 0

   [*] You can no longer receive items from other players until you've registered

notes.title: April 17th updates - Quests & Pets | Phase 1
notes.content:
[b]Quests[/b]
Almost 200 daily quests have been added to the game and when completing a quest, you have a low chance of receiving a pet in the related skill. Even if you don't get lucky there though, you'll still receive worthwhile item and experience rewards.

By default, you have 6 daily quests available to you along with 8 rerolls. Rerolls can be used on quests that you haven't yet completed to help you get quests to your liking. These can be increased to 10 daily quests and 16 rerolls by activating a Questing token, which can be found from the game shop for $4.99 (localized prices may vary) or bought from other players.

Quests in this phase are largely skilling quests, along with a few miscellaneous quests which are aimed to help new players navigate the early game (List an item for sale, send an item to your clan's vault, join a clan event etc.). Combat related quests and weekly quests will arrive in phase 2 or phase 3 in the near future.

[*] Pets are now obtainable but they are still largely in development and don't have distinctive benefits other than small defensive bonuses. They'll receive more identifying features in phase 2 of this update
[*] Each skilling quest has a small chance of providing a pet in the related skill on quest completion
[*] The cosmetics section of the Local market now contains 2 pets available for purchase for gilded players. These don't offer any stats or benefits.
[list]
[*]Lil' companion. Costs 1,000 gold
[*]Lil' swagger. Costs 250M gold
[/list][/list]

[b]Changes[/b]

notes.title: Boss leaderboards | Faster clan combat events | Lots of systems overhauled
notes.content:
Although largely invisible, the biggest changes here are the architectural changes behind the chat system which is a part of the on-going backend restructure that's taking place this year. We've got plenty of other stuff too though, so read on!

[b]Big changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Chat[/b]
[list]
[*]The chat backend has been recreated from the ground up to be a whole lot more efficient and scalable. Throughout the year, I'll be doing this to several areas of the game to optimize our systems. Ideally, there won't be any noticeable changes on your end as a result of this, but as systems are overhauled, some things might end up behaving a little differently, and some non-critical things can be reset (such as your blocked players being reset with this update).
[*]3 new channels have been added
[list]
[*]Clan recruiting. Use it to find a clan or recruit players into your clan.
[*]Combat-LFG. Use it to group up for combat.
[*]Raids-LFG. Use it to group up for raids.
[/list]
[*]Blocking a player now removes their messages from the chat for you.
[*]"Clan" chat has been renamed to be your clan's name.
[*]Ironmen no longer have access to the private clan chat.
[*]Combat party chats are now removed if you end up being the only member in it.
[*]Fixed an issue with notifications showing up on channels you had notifications disabled for.
[*]Disabled channels are now hidden from your chat so that you can fully focus on only the channels you're interested in.
[*]The small "X" button to close the chat was replaced with a proper big red "Close" button. Additionally, "Settings", "Commands" and "Disconnect" buttons were added next to it.
[*]Disabling the "Enabled" state of private messages will now fully stop you from receiving DM's.
[*]Fixed chat notification settings not visually updating when logging onto multiple accounts on the same client.
[*]When logging in, you'll no longer be notified of messages in the chat that have been sent by yourself.
[*]Chat is no longer closed when opening a player shop via the trade channel.
[*]Closing a private chat channel now asks for confirmation.
[*]When logging onto the game, you'll be automatically connected to the chat. If you don't open it for 15 minutes though, you'll be disconnected from the chat to spare server resources. (Doesn't apply if you have the Gilded rank, same as before).
[*]If you don't open the chat for an hour, you'll be disconnected from the chat and will be notified accordingly. You don't need to interact with the chat, simply opening it will reset the disconnection timer. (Doesn't apply if you have the Gilded rank, same as before).
[*]After this update launches, you'll be unable to access the clan chat for up to 30 minutes.
[*]Your blocked players and chat notification settings have been reset.
[*]Other than that, you shouldn't notice much of a change except that we may perform updates on the chat from time to time without needing to restart the entire server.
[/list]

[*][b]Clan combat events[/b]
[list]
[*]Clan combat events will now run faster. The Big ol' Turkey's base health was reduced from 4000 to 2000, and the modifiers were updated accordingly so you're gaining the same amount of experience and loot as before - just much faster.
[/list]

[*][b]Boss & raids leaderboards[/b]
[list]
[*]Your boss kills and Reckoning of the Gods completions rankings can now be found at the bottom of your leaderboards profile.
[*]Global rankings can be viewed from the "Top players" page.
[*]Note that you won't be ranked until your leaderboard profile gets saved after this update (which occurs when you log out).
[/list]

[*][b]Settings popup rework[/b]
[list]
[*]Settings categories are now separated into their own tabs for easier navigation.
[*]Language can now be changed from Settings.
[*]Most game notifications can now be disabled from the Notifications tab. These settings are saved on device so they're shared between all accounts used on the same device.
[*]The offline progress notification toggles for mobile devices can no longer be interacted with on non-mobile devices.
[/list]

[*][b]Trading history popup rework[/b]
[list]
[*]Transactions are now neatly separated into sold/bought containers with clearer and more pleasant visuals than before.
[*]Trading history is no longer limited to 20 entries.
[*]Trading history is now saved across sessions. At least for now, it's only saved on your device, meaning that trades you do on your PC won't show up on your mobile device.
[/list][/list]

[b]Smaller changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Lobby and party related buttons in raids are now hidden for ironmen.
[*]Removed the block buttons from raids & combat party member popups for the time being.
[*]The 7-day grace period will no longer be triggered when deleting a clan if the clan's total level is less than 250.
[*]Clan activity scores are now automatically reset daily (and after server updates). Experience contributions are now also tracked only for the past 24 hours to calculate a clan's activity score. The intent behind these changes is to have clan activity scores shift more often and have a larger variety of clans show up in the clan recruitment center. Will be monitoring the results and will likely make further adjustments to this after the update.
[*]The automatic eating percentage is now saved to your character rather than just the device, which means that the value is no longer shared between all your accounts.
[*]After minimizing/unfocusing and returning to the game on mobile during clan events, the server will now properly sync you up to the current event state.
[*]Auto eat percentage now applies to Picky Eater. It uses the given percentage as a target rather than a threshold. For example, if you have 100 health and auto eat percentage set to 90%, it should eat the food that'll get you the closest to 90 health if you fall below it.
[*]Tweaked the eating percentage slider graphics in combat view for a slightly cleaner look.
[*]In the clan events tab, you'll now be able to see if there are clan members in an event lobby or if an event is currently running (without needing to enter an event party).
[*]Experience from offline progress is no longer sent to your clan if you've been a member for less than 24 hours.
[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*]Optimized the way tasks listen to changes to your account throughout the game. As a result, a lot of things in the game should feel slightly smoother. Changing loadouts for example would cause a noticeable lag spike before - that's now approximately 15x faster than before and there should be no noticeable hiccup in the process anymore.
[*]Optimized the way items are loaded into the popup when listing items for sale in your shop. There used to be a slight lag spike whenever you clicked an empty slot - that lag spike should only occur when clicking a slot for the first time during a session now, subsequent listings should be smooth.
[*]Interacting with the clan vault is now a bit faster.
[/list]

[b]Fixes (some of these are already live)[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed your raid party chat being removed at the end of a raid and not being re-added until you fully re-joined a lobby.
[*]Fixed the -1/+1 buttons in player shop listing not correctly updating the listing amount.
[*]Fixed the -1/+1 buttons in the item send popup not correctly updating the listing amount.
[*]Fixed inventory gemstone breaking and enchantment scroll reading not showing the level-up popup.
[*]Fixed localization errors in some languages.
[*]Fixed the Quick exit button being uninteractable against regular monsters if you had previously been in a solo boss fight.
[*]Fixed a popup issue where clicks on the background could hide a popup that wasn't on top if you had multiple of them open.
[*]Fixed a popup issue where sometimes when the active popup, the popup's dark background wouldn't be hidden until you clicked on it.
[*]Fixed your own clan join date being shown in your clan members' profiles.
[*]If your device was running on one of a few unsupported languages, you wouldn't be able to create accounts into the game. Fixed.
[*]Fixed an issue where if you tried to list a 4th shop item from your inventory without having premium, you'd get stuck in a loading loop.
[*]Fixed clan member log out times not being correctly updated during server updates.
[*]Fixed a rare issue where multiple clan members starting a clan event at once could trigger quirky behaviour in the event.
[*]Fixed the sell price of the following items to match other items in their category: Godlike jumping rope, Elite lockpicks, Elite philosopher's stone.
[/list]

[b]Today's update brings in new ways to find party members to raid and do combat with, optional two-factor authentication to enhance your account security, improved item sending & more![/b]

[h2][b]New[/b][/h2]

    [list]

    [*]If you've blocked a player or they've blocked you, you won't see their open lobbies and they won't see yours
    [/list]
[*][b]Optional Two-factor authentication[/b]
    [list]
    [*]SMS authentication has been added to enhance account security. You can turn it on from the 2FA button which can be found underneath the Settings button in the sidebar menu from the top right
    [*]When registering a phone number, you'll be sent a SMS with a one-time passcode. Enter the code into the 2FA popup and your phone number will be linked to your account
    [*]When logging onto an account with 2FA enabled from an unknown device, a one-time passcode will be sent to your device and you'll need to submit it to be able to log in. The passcode will never be requested when logging in from known and trusted devices
    [*]More 2FA options may be added in the future. SMS authentication is a simple solution both development wise and for user experience and it works well with small online games like ours. I know that many prefer 2FA by App though and that's definitely something I want to have another look at in the future
    [*]Two-factor authentication is currently not available to US users. For an application to send text messages to US phone numbers, it requires a separate business registration and vetting process, which is currently in progress. It should at most take a week or two to be finalized if no issues come up

notes.title: Updates 28th of November - Clan recruitment center, clan updates & much more
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b] 

This update aims to tackle a pain point that's been in the game for far too long - the difficulty of finding a clan and finding members for your clan. The newly added clan recruitment center will allow clan leaders to set up parameters for their clan which players seeking clans can use to find the right fit for them. 

Related, all clans have also received a new metric: the Activity score. It's calculated automatically based on the experience input by each individual member and clans with the highest activity scores are pushed to the top of the recruitment center.

Another notable change is that recent chat messages are now queried when you log into the game. For clan chat, you'll be able to view messages from the past 24 hours.

There's not nearly all though, so read on!

[b]Clan settings & metrics[/b]
[list]
[*]Activity score: this is calculated by the game automatically and is based on the individual experience contribution of every member in the clan, based on the past few days. Clans with the highest activity score are by default shown at the top of the recruitment center. For an individual member to reach the maximum amount they can contribute towards the clan activity score, they'll need to have gained 400K experience in the past 48 hours. Note that the activity score is calculated no more often than once an hour, so it'll take some time for things to get going once the update lands
[*]Minimum total level: clans can set up a minimum total level required of players to be able to apply to their clan. Note that you can still invite players that don't meet the total level requirement
[*]Language: clans can now set up a primary language
[*]Recruiting only: turn this on to only be offered clans that are actively recruiting and aren't full. Clan leaders note: the recruiting state is off by default and you'll need to turn it on in the management page for players to be able to apply to your clan
[*]Category: 3 new categories have been added: Casual, Competitive and Hardcore. Use it to help find the right clan for you
[/list]
[b]Clan changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Clan management page overhauled, both visually and functionally. As mentioned above, here is where you can configure settings for your clan that will make it easier to get the right people into your clan
[*]The member cap for clans has been raised from 15 to 20
[*]A new clan house has been added for the most accomplished clans: Castle
[*]You can now view offline clan members
[*]You can now optionally include a message in your application when joining a clan
[*]Applications now show the applicants total level at the time of applying (doesn't apply to old applications retroactively)
[*]Clan page (the view when you're not in a clan) was reworked and now displays the most active recruiting clans rather than the top clans, among other tweaks
[*]Clan vault space IAP purchases now provide a tradeable token
[*]The unlockable clan vault slots for normal clans have been significantly raised from 40 to 200. For ironman clans, the slots were raised to 80
[*]Regular members can now claim leadership of a clan if the leader has been offline for more than 90 days. Deputy leaders are still able to claim it first at 28 days of the leader being offline
[*]"Deputy leader" text was shortened to just "Deputy" in most places
[/list]
[b]Chat changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Historic chat messages are now loaded into the chat when you log into the game to make it easier to engage with the community - especially for clans!
[list]
[*]Public channels (General, Help, Trade) messages are retrieved from the past 20 minutes
[*]Clan messages are retrieved from the past 24 hours at a cap of 50 messages
[/list]
[*]Channel configuration in settings
[list]
[*]Channels can now be disabled so that you can neither receive or send messages in them
[*]Channel notifications can now be disabled so that you can be alerted of activity only from channels you're interested in
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous changes[/b]
[list]
[*]The tutorial guide and clan event genie have received new sprites
[*]Game background brightness can now be modified from settings
[*]Confirmation popup buttons now scale up when hovered
[*]Leaderboards went through some backend changes. As a result, your leaderboards profile might be slightly out of date until you relog
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the join date of some clan members not being set correctly. As a result of this change and some larger related refactoring, the join date of every existing member in every existing clan has been set to this date
[*]Fixed the offline progress popup UI sometimes overlapping if you had a lot of item rewards
[*]Fixed all of your arrows being worn when equipping arrows, regardless of the amount you entered
[*]The game will now attempt to recalculate your clan event progress when you return to the game on a mobile device. For more context, when Idle Clans was paused or minimized on mobile devices whilst in a clan event, it would appear as if you made no progress during your time away from the game. This wasn't the case - as long as you're connected to the server, the server will correctly calculate the correct progression for you even if it doesn't appear that way on your device. 
[*]Ironmen can now send the loadout token to normal players
[*]Fixed an issue in clan events with auto run & task loadouts where the item rewards and your equipped items could be added to your inventory in a different order between the client and server, causing a desync
[*]Fixed the disconnection popup often showing an old message
[*]Fixed the "Previous tier cape" being listed as a requirement for buying a tier 1 mastery cape
[*]Fixed the combat group leader leaving the group sometimes causing unexpected errors to occur during group combat
[*]Fixed an edge case issue causing food sometimes to go out of sync between the client and server during combat
[*]Fixed manually looting boss keys without boss hunter unlocked sometimes causing your keys to go out of sync between client and server
[/list]

notes.title: 2023 Halloween event is here!

notes.title: New high level combat zone, new jewelry tasks, dozens of new items & much more!
notes.content:
[h1]Foreword on the Next Update[/h1]
With more and more items being added into the game, it's becoming increasingly difficult and annoying to swap items around to get most out of the activities you're doing. As such, the next update is going to focus on a loadout/preset system that'll allow you to create different layouts for a range of activities in the game that you can then easily switch between without having to scavenge through your entire inventory. Some other requested inventory management options may or may not make it into that update - we'll see how much time loadouts end up taking!

[b]Anyway, onto this update![/b]
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]A new high level combat zone has been added: [b]Lair of beasts![/b]
  [list]
  [*]6 new enemies to defeat
  [*]The enemies have exceptionally high health and defence but are fairly modest in strength. This means that with enough food, you'll be able to grind them out without needing to have very high combat stats (though it certainly helps). As their defences are so high, you'll find that raid weapons work very well against them - but they aren't required. Group combat should also prove more beneficial here than in the previous zones!
  [*]Drop tables offer new, tradeable and equipable unique items. You can check out the new monster drop tables in-game for specific information on them:
    [list]
    [*]Centaur's shield & helmet
    [*]Necromancer's hat & boots
    [*]Minotaur's horns
    [*]Chef's hat
    [*]Warrior's platebody
    [*]Granite shield
    [*]Dragonscale shield & boots
    [*]Artisan's boots
    [*]Treasure hunter gloves (offers a 50% higher chance of finding chests when doing Agility)
    [*]Silver, gold & diamond symbols for the new craftable jewelry. More on the uses for these in the next bullet point.
    [/list]
  [*]Skilling consumables introduction. When you have these in your inventory, you'll receive some bonus experience for every completed task and the material will be lost in the process. When you have these in your inventory and attempt to start a task, you'll be asked if you want to use them for the requested task.

With a well trained party, you might be able to get away with having less high level skills. Teamwork is key!

There is no cost to enter raids and there is no limit how many raids you can complete, but you will need to have a total of 25 bosses slain before you can start raiding. Note that boss kills prior to this update weren't recorded, so everyone starts fresh here.

With Reckoning of the Gods, almost two dozen new items were introduced to the game along with a couple of related new crafting tasks. I won't list them here, but you can check most of them out in the new Raids tab in-game.

Best of luck, hope you enjoy the new content!

notes.title: June 8th updates - Toolbelt item & upgrades, new task, offline potions & more
notes.content:
Hello everyone, hope your summers are off to a great start! Let's have a look at the what's been going on in Idle Clans during the last couple of weeks.

[b]iOS Release[/b]:
Getting Idle Clans on iOS has been a major focus in the past few weeks, and I'm thrilled to announce that it has been approved on the App Store. However, some final touches are needed before its official release. Barring any unexpected issues, I anticipate launching the iOS version next week.

[b]Upcoming Update[/b]:
Before diving into the current updates, I wanted to provide a brief overview of what's coming next. I will be working on fresh and juicy content for both individuals and clans, catering to your feedback and suggestions. Since this will be a substantial undertaking, the update may take longer than the usual two weeks. I'll keep you informed about the progress in our Discord channel's #game-workshop channel.

[b][u]Updates[/u][/b]:
[list]
[*]A new item has been added: [b]Toolbelt[/b]. It's an equippable item that goes into the new Belt equipment slot. It's currently obtainable from rare and exceptional treasure chests (8% and 4% drop chances respectively), but will likely be moved to future content as something more fitting comes along. The Toolbelt on its own does not offer anything beyond some minimal defensive stats - you'll need to purchase the new Toolbelt upgrade for the item to utilize your tools. Once upgraded and equipped, the toolbelt will provide the benefit of the highest level tool in your inventory for a given task without needing to equip the tool. Here is how the upgrades are structured:
[list]
[*]Tier 1: unlocks Woodcutting and Fishing tools, costs 500K gold
[*]Tier 2: unlocks Mining and Smithing tools, costs 1M gold
[*]Tier 3: unlocks Cooking and Crafting tools, costs 2M gold
[*]Tier 4: unlocks Agility and Plundering tools, costs 3M gold
[*]Tier 5: unlocks Foraging and Farming tools, costs 4M gold
[*]Tier 6: unlocks Brewing and Carpentry tools, costs 5M gold
[/list]
Each tier requires level 70 in the related skills. Unlocked tool types will show in the Toolbelt item's description once one or more upgrades have been purchased.
[*]A logging system has been added for clans. Every meaningful action is recorded and available for leaders of a clan to view from the Management section of your clan's page. To start off, the last 25 actions of individual clan members and 100 of the last combined actions of all clan members are stored. These numbers may be raised in the future if need arises.

notes.title: 22nd of May updates - New upgrade, new plundering task, QoL changes & much more
notes.content:
Starting off with a honourable mention for Noscar for kindly offering us his time and giving our website some much needed love. It looks exponentially better than it did before. Thank you Noscar!

The server has been running very smoothly since the last update and I'm starting to feel the pressure ease up from all of that. Lots of bugs have been squashed and there are still some less urgent ones left to deal with, but now with the bigger fires put out I'm starting to be able to focus on new content and more meaningful updates for the game. It's building up to be a great summer for Idle Clans!

From here on out, I'm going to commit to pushing an update biweekly. Updates may occasionally pop up more often than that if something urgent needs taking care of, or it could take longer if there's larger content update coming up that doesn't make it into the 2 week sprint. I'll be sure to update the community in those cases though. The next update target as such is 5th of June.

On to the game updates!
[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] A new upgrade has been added: Boss slayer. It costs a modest 25M gold and once unlocked, will allow you to repeatedly fight the same boss until your keys run out. The upgrade works for groups too and if any group member has it unlocked, it'll be active for the group leader as well.
[*] A new popup has been added to group combat to better keep track of how the group is doing. It contains the collected loot + dealt & taken damage for each player in the group. It can be manually accessed from the "Loot and stats" view, but it will also show automatically when you leave a group or when the run comes to a natural end.
[*] A new Plundering task, the Sports center, has been added. It has a level 60 requirement to start and drops the new Agility training tool, the Jumping rope
[*] A new dish has been added: Beef stew! It has a level 80 requirement and heals 19 health upon consumption. You'll need 2 potatoes, 4 carrots and a piece of cooked quality meat to prepare it.
[*] Game rules have been added to our website and are accessible in the game from the settings popup
[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changes to how boosts from enchantments and potions are applied. Currently in the game, they provide a flat bonus to your stats instead of multiplying your actual stats by a given percentage. This caused a very noticable imbalance in the game's combat, especially from mid-game onwards. You would stop taking damage from high level monsters much sooner than made sense and bosses would become too easy to take on even solo. For example, if you had a 50% chance to block attacks from demons and wore 4 pieces of diamond jewelry with defence enchantments, your block chance would raise from 50% to 70% (4x5%). The 20% will now be applied to your base 50% block chance instead of adding on top of it, so in this scenario you would now have a 60% block chance.
[*] As higher level players have already seen, the skilling speed cap (80%) is currently too easily obtainable and causes a greater influx of items throughout the game than what is good for the economy. In an effort to improve the balance here, housing upgrades and clan housing now give a flat experience boost to skills similarly to the ad boost rather than decreasing the time it takes to complete skilling tasks.
[*] Yoink chance has been lowered from 25% to 15%. 25% was decided upon when you were still limited to having 1 key a a time. Now with the design of that changed, Yoink needed a little bit of fine tuning as well
[*] Combat will now continue on log in after combat offline progress
[*] Rewrote the login limiter system. You should no longer incorrectly be locked out from the game on any OS/platform
[*] Idle Clans Bot will now include the player receiving loot and the loot itself in the "boss defeated" message
[*] Bosses now drop ore instead of bars and raw food in place of cooked food
[*] Max experience in a skill is now 500M
[*] Experience in maxed skills will no longer show as "Maxed" but keep on showing the experience post-120
[*] Potion of forgery will no longer work on Astronomical bars
[*] Confirmation popup will now be shown when attempting to sell enchanted gear and tools
[*] Gemstones, clubs and the Royal clan icon have had their graphics updated (ty Madao!)
[*] Small city plundering task requirement was lowered from 55 to 50
[*] Premium and boss hunter status are now shown at the bottom right of the profile where boosts used to be
[*] Tasks now display how many of the relevant items you own
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Enchanting level requirements not being enforced correctly client side when dragging scrolls from inventory to equipment
[*] Zeus had a higher chance of dropping nothing than intended, fixed
[*] Fixed some mistakes in client side DPS calcs. Additionally, as combat uses a high amount of RNG, simulations are now ran in the client side calcs to provide more realistic calculations. As a result, you'll see slightly different hit chances and DPS each time you open the damage calcs popup.
[*] Fixed an issue with ad boost and offline progress. The experience boost was correctly factored in on the server, but the server was sending the unmodified experience to the client causing you to see incorrect numbers on login
[*] Fixed damage dealt during offline combat being shown incorrectly when you had an ad boost active during offline time
[*] Fixed a visual experience desync that would occasionally occur when resuming an offline task upon logging in
[*] Fixed whitelists not resetting when logging from one account to another when the second account didn't have any whitelisted players
[*] Fixed a visual issue with ad boost calculations in Task stats popup
[*] Accounts logged out during a tutorial task had some trouble processing offline progress tasks when they logged back in. Offline progress is now disabled for players that are in the middle of the tutorial.
[*] Fixed loot tables never rolling the highest amount available (e.g. the 1-2 Exceptional chest drop from bosses would only ever drop 1 chest)
[*] Rewrote automatic eating in combat, should no longer get the rare issue in group combat where swapping food slots throws an error and causes the team to disband
[*] Fixed bosses being potentially accessible without enforcing the key requirement if you knew your way around the client and packet protocols. Thanks kloppie5 for finding the issue and reporting it
[*] Removed the "Doing this will end group combat" confirmation request popup when the player tried to start another task while in group combat. That is no longer how it works.
[*] Fixed enemies starting at no health instead of their actual max health in offline progress logic
[*] Fixed experience and item animations occasionally stopping animating after relogs
[*] Fixed an issue where if you tried to send an item to another player that you no longer owned you would get a never ending loading animation
[*] Fixed an annoying issue where sending private messages would sometimes throw you into the incorrect chatbox channel
[*] When a chat was removed from your chatbox, such as the combat team channel upon your team being disbanded, you would get sent to the default channel. You will now only be sent to the general channel if you were currently active in the channel that was deleted
[*] Fixed an issue with group combat eating
[*] Combat panels will now correct themselves to their original positions if they get messed up due to resolution changes
[*] Hopefully fixed the issue with clan quests not always immediately resetting on day change
[*] Slightly modified how the Costs part of tasks with resources are displayed so that tasks with a lot of resource costs don't have their font sizes scaled down
[*] Boss runs will now end if a player leaves and the remaining member(s) are dead
[*] Fixed deaths in group combat sometimes leaving the dying player at non-zero health and the RIP panel not always appearing
[/list]
